core.headline: Mill Cottage, Riverside Lane, Yalding ME18
core.summary: A detached cottage dating from c.1850 with a garden extending to the River Beult in Yalding village. The ground floor has flooded twice; flood protection measures are in place and insurance is through a Flood Re-backed policy.
core.listing:
Mill Cottage is a detached cottage dating from c.1850 in Yalding, with a garden extending to the River Beult. The cottage has exposed beams and a wood-burning stove.

The ground floor comprises two reception rooms and a kitchen. One reception room has the wood-burning stove and exposed beams. The first floor has three bedrooms and two bathrooms.

The garden extends to the riverbank of the River Beult. A driveway provides parking.

Yalding is a village with a pub and primary school.

The property is offered freehold for offers in excess of £575,000. Council Tax band E (Maidstone Borough Council). EPC rating E. Construction is standard. Electricity is mains supply. Water is mains supply and metered. Sewerage is via a septic tank. Heating is oil-fired central heating. Broadband is FTTC. Mobile signal has good outdoor coverage on major networks. The ground floor flooded from the River Beult in December 2013 and February 2020; flood doors and non-return valves were fitted in 2021; the property is insured through a Flood Re-backed policy. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield or mining issues are none known.
